title: What Do Trucks Carry? 5 Working Trucks with Bolt
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Bolt the little tow truck, and welcome to Tiny Truck Town!
Today we're finding out what five working trucks carry.
Can you count them with me? One, two, three, four, five!

lines: Here's our first truck. Here's a clue: it carries rocks in its big bed! Can you guess?
A dump truck carries rocks, sand and dirt.
Its bed tips up to pour it all out.
Can you carry a pretend heavy rock? Heave, ho!
Can you guess what we call the back part of a dump truck?
The bed! Just like a bed, but for rocks.
Let's say it together: DUMP TRUCK!
Dump trucks bring rocks to build roads.
Who's next? Here's a clue: it carries something wet and gooey! Can you guess?
A cement mixer carries wet concrete.
Its drum spins all the way there.
Can you stir a pretend bowl? Mix, mix!
Can you guess what concrete becomes?
Sidewalks and roads! It dries hard as rock.
Let's say it together: CEMENT MIXER!
The concrete slides out of a chute at the building spot.
Who's next? Here's a clue: it carries trash away! Can you guess?
A garbage truck carries trash to keep streets clean.
Its robot arm can lift the bin.
Can you lift your arms like a robot arm? Beep boop!
Can you guess how it fits so much trash?
It squishes the trash inside, to make room for more!
Let's say it together: GARBAGE TRUCK!
Recycling trucks carry cans and paper to be made new.
Who's next? Here's a clue: it carries lots of things in long cars! Can you guess?
Trains carry all kinds of things, like grain, cars and toys.
Can you be a train with your arms? Choo choo!
Can you guess? Can a train carry new cars?
Yes! Some train cars carry brand new cars to the store.
Trains can carry a lot, all at once.
Who's last? Here's a clue: it pulls tools on the farm! Can you guess?
A tractor pulls tools that help plant seeds.
It can pull a trailer full of hay, too!
Can you pull a pretend wagon? Pull, pull!
Can you guess what's in the trailer?
Hay! Hay is food for farm animals like cows and horses.
Tractors are a farmer's best helper.

recap: Trains carry all kinds of things.
And tractors pull hay for farm animals!
outro: Which working truck was your favorite? Be kind, and wave hello to the trucks you see.
Bye, friends! See you in Tiny Truck Town!
